summary: The file annotates the three MassPrep QC standard injections (Velos_120203_01-03). RAW sample names and headers confirm they are unlabelled 25-min CID runs of the same standard. They are correctly kept out of the TMT file, with conservative reserved values. Only minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; no producer transcript; report.md and evidence.json treated as untrusted; evidence read only from scratchpad/PXD004993/ (PRIDE project JSON accession verified = PXD004993; file-list FTP URLs all under /PXD004993/)

spec_compliance.evidence: ms-proteomics is usable alone (templates.yaml), and no organism template applies because organism is 'not applicable', which the column allows. All required columns are present. Assay name is one per file. Technical replicates 1-3 of a single source with biological replicate 1. Label 'label free sample'. No factor columns, which is acceptable for a QC-only file.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in the offline cache: MS:1001742 LTQ Orbitrap Velos; MS:1001251 Trypsin; MS:1000133 CID; PRIDE:0000627 DDA; MS:1002038 label free sample; PRIDE:0000544 quality control sample. The remaining values are reserved words.

source_evidence.evidence: raw_sample_names.json: all three files are 'MassPrep5 Std 10 fmol/ul 120120', method EASY_nLCMS2_grad7_37_25min4uleq_1.6kV_111130.meth. raw_header_check.json: LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS, Activation Type CID only (no HCD). They are the only RAW files without a set/fraction name.

file_mapping.evidence: The 3 files are in files.json, files_compact.json and README.txt (IDs 105-107) and do not overlap the 96 TMT files. Together the two SDRFs cover all 99 RAW files.

design_consistency.evidence: One source (MassPrep5_standard_QC), three injections as technical replicates 1-3, fraction 1, biological replicate 1. This matches the identical sample names.

omission_safety.evidence: Organism, organism part, disease and material type are 'not applicable'; tolerances and modifications are 'not available'. Trypsin is weakly supported (see minor finding). No invented composition, organism or search settings.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock /tmp/sdrf_validate.lock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -s annotations/PXD004993-lfq.sdrf.tsv -t ms-proteomics --use_ols_cache_only -> 'Everything seems to be fine', exit 0; same without -t exit 0; sdrf-tools check --offline -> CLEAN (4 terms, 0 hallucinated), exit 0; sdrf-tools score -> 88/100 (organism 'not applicable'; no factor columns, expected for a QC-only file). 25 columns on all 4 lines; no CR/BOM or empty cells.

findings.message: The phenotype column holds a free-text run description ('instrument QC standard (RAW sample name: ...)'), not an observable trait of the sample.
findings.evidence: TERMS.tsv defines phenotype (clinical-metadata template) as observable characteristics or traits. characteristics[sample type]='quality control sample' already records the QC role.
findings.correction: Drop the column or move the text to a comment column (e.g. comment[sample description]).

findings.message: Trypsin for the MassPrep standard is not stated in the saved evidence.
findings.evidence: The sample name gives only 'MassPrep5 Std'. Indirect support: README.txt maps IDs 105-107 (these files) to F020253_pep_set1.xml, whose search used CLE semiTrypsin and whose FILE parameter is Velos_120203_01.raw.
findings.correction: Add the supporting reasoning (commercial tryptic digest standard; included in the set-1 semiTrypsin search) to the evidence manifest.

findings.location: evidence manifest limitation on QC runs
findings.message: The manifest says search settings for the QC runs are not stated, but the deposited set-1 Mascot search includes them.
findings.evidence: README.txt maps 105-107 to F020253_pep_set1.xml; the pepXML FILE parameter is Velos_120203_01.raw.
findings.correction: Keeping 'not available' for tolerances and modifications is acceptable, because the TMT modifications would misdescribe an unlabelled standard. Reword the limitation to say the QC runs were merged into the set-1 TMT search.
